g.text: fig 4 — what the projection does to the geometry

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #898781

g.text: W_p ∈ ℝ¹²⁸ˣ¹⁶ is one linear map shared by every patch and every channel. any linear map is rotate → scale → rotate (its SVD), so it moves the patch cloud without tearing it.
